3245.title: Sidebar footer disclosure loses state across route-mode remounts
3245.rootCauseOneLine: The active disclosure key is hook-local to AppSidebar, which wide settings and tools routes unmount before a fresh hook resets the key to null.
3245.proposedFix: Retain the active managed-footer key in the existing host module and update it on every open, close, toggle, and dismiss action.
3245.caveats: The browser screenshots use a deterministic generic provider response to exclude private account data; the route replacement and disclosure state are production behavior, and the focused test is provider-independent.
